Free delivery on every order over forty pounds, and every plant comes with a thirty day guarantee.

Plants for small homes

Fern & Stone grows hardy house plants in a greenhouse on the edge of the city. Every plant is raised from a cutting or a seed, potted in peat free compost, and checked for pests before it leaves us.

Start with the full list of plants, read the planting guide before you repot anything, and keep the watering guide close when the heating comes on in autumn. You can read about the greenhouse too.

Fern & Stone, 12 Market Lane, Bristol. Open Tuesday to Sunday.
